Daily Devotional

May 8

14 Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? (Hebrews 1:14 KJV)

This is speaking of the Angels, and they are all ministering spirits. Notice that they are sent to minister to us (who shall be) Christians, as we are the heirs of salvation. Praise God that He would send His Angels to minister to us, and He does that even before we are saved, as through His foreknowledge He knows who will accept His Son Jesus, and be saved. He does not control who is saved (2 Peter 3:9), or damned, but He is able to know those that will accept Jesus.

What a wonderful God we have, to have Angels taking care of us even before we become His heirs. If we would only realize all that God has done for us, we would love Him all the more. The only way that you can ever know what God has done for us is to study the Word of God (Holy Bible), and come to know God intimately (John 17:3), which is the point of salvation, and become disciples indeed (John 8:31). The more you learn about our Father in Heaven, the more in love with Him you will become, as He is so very awesome, and His love for us is beyond our human understanding (Ephesians 3:19), as He is love (1 John 4:8). Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
